_help: Website settings. Change the words between the quote marks. See README.md for what each one does.
tagline: News and stories from the eight states of Northeast India
_whatsappHelp: Paste your WhatsApp Channel link here (it starts with https://whatsapp.com/channel/). The WhatsApp buttons appear on the site once this is filled.
_googleHelp: Only needed if Google Search Console asks for an 'HTML tag': paste just the code inside content="..." here.

social._help: Links to your social media pages. Leave empty ("") to hide one. They appear as a row of buttons in the footer.

publisher._help: Shown on the About, Contact and Grievance pages. Fill in the real details before applying for ads.
publisher.name: InsightNE News

_widerHelp: National and world news is included only when it is important, and at most maxOutsideNortheastPerRun such stories are kept per run, so Northeast news always comes first.

editors._help: People who sign in with EDITOR_PASSWORD. If canPublish is true, the stories they write go live straight away; if false, they wait in Pending for the admin.

facebook._help: Posting to your Facebook page. Needs FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID and FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN in Vercel (see docs/5-FACEBOOK.md). If autoPost is true, every story you APPROVE is also posted to Facebook. If false, use the POST TO FACEBOOK button.

autoPublish._help: FUTURE OPTION. Keep "enabled": false. If you ever set it to true, stories come out without your approval ONLY when every source of the story has "autoPublish": true in sources.json AND the story is not marked NEEDS EXTRA CHECK.
